steps.en: A Proceed to Revival button is shown while notices remain
steps.id: Tombol Proceed to Revival tampil selama masih ada notice

steps.en: Proceed stops and warns if the reason is missing
steps.id: Proceed berhenti dan memberi peringatan jika alasan kosong

steps.en: After Proceed, a summary of notices appears to confirm
steps.id: Setelah Proceed, ringkasan notice muncul untuk dikonfirmasi
steps.why_en: Proceed only opens a generic yes/no prompt; the summary sits in a separate tab the officer must open.
steps.why_id: Proceed hanya membuka pertanyaan ya/tidak umum; ringkasan ada di tab terpisah yang harus dibuka sendiri oleh officer.

steps.en: Nothing is changed until the officer approves
steps.id: Belum ada data berubah sampai officer menyetujui
